subtitle: Master rhythmic guitar playing through real song examples and music theory understanding.

columns.title: Feel Over Precision
columns.text: Great rhythm guitar isn't just about playing the right notes at the right time—it's about creating a feel that makes people want to move.

columns.title: Contextual Learning
columns.text: Each rhythmic pattern serves the song. Learn when and why different patterns work through analysis of real musical examples.

topics.title: Strumming Patterns
topics.description: Master basic and advanced strumming patterns through analysis of real songs and their rhythmic foundations.
topics.theory: Time signatures, rhythmic subdivision, accent patterns

topics.title: Fingerpicking Rhythms
topics.description: Learn fingerpicking patterns that create rhythmic complexity while maintaining melodic independence.

topics.title: Palm Muting & Dynamics
topics.description: Understand how palm muting creates rhythmic texture and dynamics in different musical contexts.

topics.title: Syncopation & Off-beats
topics.description: Explore syncopated rhythms and how they create tension and groove in popular music.

topics.title: Shuffle & Swing Rhythms
topics.description: Master shuffle and swing feels essential for blues, jazz, and many rock songs.
topics.theory: Triplet feel, swing eighth notes, blues shuffle

topics.title: Latin Rhythms
topics.description: Learn Latin guitar rhythms including bossa nova, samba, and Latin rock patterns.
topics.theory: Clave rhythms, Latin percussion patterns, polyrhythm

topics.title: Reggae & Ska Rhythms
topics.description: Understand the distinctive upstroke emphasis and rhythmic patterns of reggae and ska music.
topics.theory: Off-beat emphasis, skank rhythm, reggae feel

topics.title: Funk Rhythms
topics.description: Master the tight, percussive rhythms that define funk guitar playing and groove.
topics.theory: Sixteenth note feel, ghost notes, rhythmic precision

steps.title: Foundation
steps.description: Start with basic strumming patterns and palm muting to build your rhythmic foundation.

steps.title: Complexity
steps.description: Add syncopation and fingerpicking to create more sophisticated rhythmic textures.

steps.title: Style
steps.description: Master genre-specific rhythms like shuffle, reggae, and Latin patterns.

steps.title: Mastery
steps.description: Develop advanced funk rhythms and polyrhythmic concepts for professional-level playing.

columns.title: Metronome First:
columns.text: Always practice with a metronome to develop internal timing. Start slow and gradually increase tempo while maintaining accuracy.

columns.title: Feel the Groove:
columns.text: Focus on how the rhythm makes you feel. Great rhythm players create a pocket that makes the music breathe and flow naturally.

nextSteps.title: 🚀 Start Your Rhythmic Journey
nextSteps.description: Begin with fundamental strumming patterns to build your rhythmic foundation, then expand into style-specific techniques.
